gen-fs-zina-gf-science-gothic: Science Gothic cuts every letter at a single depth, with stroke ends set far apart so each one reads on its own. Science Gothic would swallow a Zina heading made small, since its fat stems and hairline crossbars need size to show.
gen-fs-zina-gf-syncopate: Sharp and striking, Zina swings from fat downstrokes to threadlike upstrokes above a body that never shades at all. Syncopate runs like technical-pen lines, open and steady.
gen-fs-zina-manrope: Refined and striking, Zina's closed letters carry fat downstrokes and hairline gaps, while Manrope opens every curve wide. Zina is for showing off; Manrope is for settling in.
gen-fs-zina-satoshi: Heavy strokes meet wispy ones in Zina, a pen-cut look set over Satoshi's monoline sans with its soaring x-height. And where Zina flickers between fat and thread, Satoshi keeps every stroke cut to one width.
gen-fs-zina-switzer: Zina pairs fat stems and wiry thin arms with a moderate lowercase height, giving headings a pen-cut sparkle. Switzer answers with tubular, wire-like sans-serif letters and a tall waist line, so the page gets two distinct voices.
gen-fs-zina-work-sans: Striking from the first line, Zina closes its letters around fat stems and razor-fine joins, while Work Sans opens its c tips wide. Work Sans carries the same visual mass in every part, so paragraphs feel sturdy.
gen-gf-abel-fs-literata: Literata is a bookish serif with moderately modulated strokes and wide, unclosed curves. Abel sits above it in close-fitting sans-serif letters with no tilted stress, so a longer read feels modern up top and warm below.
gen-gf-abhaya-libre-fs-bespoke-sans: Dignified bold-and-hairline contrast up top, with curves that open outward. Bespoke Sans below keeps low contrast and generous space between curve ends and stems, so the serif heading gets room to be traditional.
gen-gf-aboreto-mulish: Mulish draws a modern sans-serif with no thick-and-thin modulation and a large x-height beside short ascenders. And Aboreto above it brings thick strokes next to hair-thin ones, so a long read stays inviting under a commanding title.
gen-gf-aboreto-poppins: Wide-spaced and commanding, Aboreto stretches its open bowls above a tall, sturdy body. Poppins brings a line width that never swells or tapers, so the pair's strongest quality is how loud and quiet divide the work.
